events.name: Freedom and Desire: The Films of Lee Chang-dong
events.blurb: The first NYC retrospective of all eight Lee Chang-dong features. It closes Nov 24 with Possible Love on 35mm plus the U.S. premiere of his short Heartbeat.

tickets.label: Tickets on sale for remaining shows
tickets.note: Poetry (Nov 4), Burning (Nov 23), and Possible Love + Heartbeat (Nov 24) are listed with tickets

events.tips: The Nov 24 35mm closer is the one most likely to sell out at the Paris.

events.name: NewFest 38: The New York LGBTQ+ Film Festival
events.venues: SVA Theatre (hub), BAM Rose Cinemas (Oct 16-22), Nitehawk Prospect Park, other Manhattan/Brooklyn venues
events.blurb: New York's main LGBTQ+ film festival, now in its 38th edition and running through Oct 25.

tickets.label: Tickets on sale
tickets.note: newfest.org says tickets are on sale now; the original on-sale date isn't stated.

events.tips: The festival is already running. Buy remaining screenings at newfest.org, or through BAM and Nitehawk for their NewFest shows.

events.name: William Greaves 100
events.blurb: Centennial retrospective of the documentary pioneer (Symbiopsychotaxiplasm, Nationtime), timed to the release of his posthumous Once Upon a Time in Harlem at FLC and BAM.

tickets.label: Tickets on sale
tickets.note: Listed with showtimes and tickets on filmforum.org as of the check date

events.tips: The Oct 23 Nationtime screening has an introduction by Liani Greaves and Sandra Schulberg.

events.name: Area Coded: American Regionalism in Film
events.blurb: BAM series on specific American places, with films including The Texas Chain Saw Massacre, Eve's Bayou, Grey Gardens, Giant, and Ruby in Paradise.

events.name: Optic Nerve: A Tribute to Glass Eye Pix
events.blurb: Tribute to 40 years of Larry Fessenden's indie horror label Glass Eye Pix, running over Halloween week.

tickets.label: Tickets on sale
tickets.note: IFC Center lists 'Tickets on sale now!'

events.name: The Spirit Compels Her: Possession and the Demonization of Women
events.blurb: BAM series on women and girls accused of possession, which pairs with the Devils restoration.

events.name: DOC NYC
events.venues: IFC Center, SVA Theatre, Village East by Angelika (in person Nov 11-19); online through Nov 29
events.blurb: America's largest documentary festival (17th edition) and a key stop for Oscar-season docs. Opening night is The Hummingbird Paints Fragrant Songs, with 200+ films.

tickets.label: Online Film Pass early-bird ends
tickets.note: $199 early bird through Oct 18, then $250

tickets.label: Tickets & passes on sale online
tickets.note: 'Tickets and passes are available for purchase online now' (docnyc.net).

tickets.label: In-person box office opens
tickets.note: In-person ticket and pass sales start at the IFC Center box office

events.tips: IFC Center members pay member prices ($16 regular, $25 for gala screenings) with no online fee. The 10-ticket pack ($170) excludes opening, centerpiece, and closing nights.

events.name: All of a Sudden: Hamaguchi in-person sneak previews
events.blurb: Ryusuke Hamaguchi and Tao Okamoto appear in person at sneak previews of his 196-minute Cannes winner, before it opens at FLC Nov 25.
events.tips: FLC members get pre-sale access to FLC events. Watch filmlinc.org for the on-sale date, which wasn't announced as of Oct 21.

events.name: Rossellini 120
events.blurb: A 26-film Roberto Rossellini retrospective for his 120th birthday, co-presented with Cinecitta.
events.tips: Film Forum didn't list an on-sale date as of Oct 21. Members pay $12 vs $18 general.

events.name: Film Comment Live: Best of 2026
events.blurb: Film Comment's annual live countdown of its year-end critics' poll, with the editors and guests.
events.tips: FLC says Film Comment subscribers get first access to tickets.

events.name: New York Jewish Film Festival
events.venues: Walter Reade Theater, Film at Lincoln Center
events.blurb: Annual January festival from the Jewish Museum and FLC. 2027 dates aren't announced; the 2026 edition ran Jan 14-28 and 2025 ran Jan 15-29.

tickets.label: FLC & Jewish Museum member early access

tickets.label: General on-sale
tickets.note: Estimate based on 2026, when the general on-sale was Thu Dec 18 at noon

events.tips: The opening film is priced higher and usually goes first. The 3+ film package saves a few dollars per ticket.

tickets.label: FLC & MoMA member early access
tickets.note: Estimate based on 2026, when member early access was Wed Mar 11 at noon after a Mar 10 lineup announcement

tickets.note: Estimate based on 2026, when the general on-sale was Fri Mar 13 at noon

events.name: Open Roads: New Italian Cinema
events.blurb: FLC and Cinecitta's annual showcase of new Italian films. 2027 dates aren't announced; the 25th edition in 2026 ran May 28-Jun 4.

tickets.label: Lineup announcement / on-sale
tickets.note: Rough estimate. The 2026 lineup was announced Apr 29, but the announcement didn't give an on-sale date. FLC members usually get presale a couple of days before the general sale.

events.tips: An All-Access Pass was $140 ($120 for FLC members) in 2026.

events.name: Brooklyn Film Festival (30th edition)
events.venues: 2026 venues: BRIC (Fort Greene), 100 Sutton Studios (Greenpoint), Wythe Hotel (Williamsburg), plus online
events.blurb: Brooklyn's long-running international competitive festival. 2027 dates aren't announced; the 2026 edition ran May 29-Jun 7.
events.tips: No ticketing history was found. Check the site in spring 2027.

events.name: Tribeca Festival
events.venues: Lower Manhattan and venues citywide (venues TBA)
events.blurb: The 26th Tribeca Festival: film premieres, talks, and immersive work. Dates are officially announced.

events.name: BAMcinemaFest
events.blurb: BAM's summer festival of American independent film. Status is unclear: BAM's 2026 film calendar has no 2026 edition, so it may be on hiatus. These are placeholder late-June dates based on past editions.
events.tips: Not confirmed to be returning. Treat it as watch-only until BAM announces it.

events.name: JAPAN CUTS
events.blurb: North America's largest festival of new Japanese film. 2027 dates aren't announced; the 2026 edition ran Jul 8-18.
